content: Yosepa Talinau Hi Nok Palabuina Itipita Aloliya Beniyamina
Panuwa Kenani elana galebu iyoho ya i bwatabwata.
Inoke sauga witi toto valila hi ahem Itipita hi an haba, yaka Yakobo i baek natunau bolau elal i ba, “Nuku sikal Itipita ge witi enuna al nuku pwamola kaiwela.”
Yaa Yuda i baek tamaliya elana i ba, “Itipita wali tologugui bwabwatana valila i ba nabinabi eliyama i ba, ‘Ebo nige alomiu talimiu nuku nenem, he nige na tatalam nuku tutuk ge nuku kikiteyau.’
Ebo talima nu talamwan aloma naha nok, inoke naha nok yaka aanan naha pwamola kaiwem.
Yaa ebo nige nu tatalamwan, he nige naha nonok. Kaiwena tau o iyaka i ba haba eliyama i ba, ‘Ebo nige alomiu talimiu nuku nenem, he nige na tatalam nuku tutuk ge nuku kikiteyau.’”
Yakobo, alana etega al Isileli, i baek elal i ba, “Ga i ola ge tau o wana wasa ku pek ku ba, ‘Talima etega al iyoho,’ yaka eliyana o pulowan bwabwatana ya ku pem.”

Anana hi lahe hi ba, “Tau o i nel bubunima ama kaiwema ge tutumeyau kaiweliya. I ba, ‘Tamamiu iyoho ya i minamina? Tab talimiu etegana al i gan?’ Inoke wana nel lahena ya te ha baunan elana. He nige ha aatena te abwe ni baem eliyama ni ba, ‘Talimiu nuku en pwatanim.’”
Inoke Yuda i baek tamaliya Isileli elana i ba, “Geman u talamwan ni nem alou, yaka sauga ya te naha egon. Inoke owa ge ama alomeyau natumeyau bahi galebu kaiwena ge ta aaliga.

Ya batelewa nau na matahikan, inoke pulowanina nu pem o kalikalivai. Ebo nige na een pasikal ge na teteli maninimwa, he nau iyaka ya gegi eliyam, inoke yawaliu miminana ana woliwoli o ni minem eliyau.
Binimala nige nu kukuhikagima ge sauga naha aahe nabiyan, he bosowaima te iyaka naha nok ge naha nem palabuina te.”

Inoke tamaliya Isileli i baek elal i ba, “Ebo ni ola o, he nuku ginol ni ola hiwe. Wala panuwa enona waiwaisal ona nuku usan wami nabwa gamwanaa: bugul bwaleliya waiwaisana enuna, luvi uleya enuna, aanan amnana ana epawaisi enuna, enonu meya enuna, ge ebwakil pistasiyo ge almon
enowaliya enuna. Inoke nuku na nuku pek tologugui o elana wami mulolu.
Mani toto valila ku noahe, he sauga ya nuku daboli ge nuku ahe. Kaiwena mani toto hi teli pasikal wami beig awanaa nasi nuku pek pasikal ga elal. Tabana eba hi usan pagegi.
Talimiu Beniyamina al nuku ahe, inoke sauga ya etimwawa nuku egon nuku sikal tologugui o elana.

Ya awanun Yabowaine Togasisi Hot tologugui o ni paatilomwanan yaka atena ni lomwanagimiu, inoke talimiu toto etegana alona ge Beniyamina ni talamwagil alomiyau nuku sikalim eliyau. Yaa ebo natuwau na payaomalil, he iyaka ya payaomalil.”
Inoke natunau wali mulolu hi ahe, ge mani toto valila hi noahe hi daboli ge hi ahe. Yaka avaliya ge Beniyamina etimwawa hi egon hi na Itipita ge hi masal Yosepa eliyana.

Sauga Yosepa i kite Beniyamina iyoho avaliya, inoke i baek wana limi ana totuwalali wali tohouwa elana i ba, “Bolau ya nu enil nihi na no limiya, yaka sipi o ebo goti o ebo bulumwakau etega nu tagapaaliga ge aanan nu ginol. Nasi alalati alowau naha anan.”
Totuwalali i ginol ola Yosepa wana baaba, yaka i enil ge nihi na Yosepa wana limiya.

Hi nanawa limi kaiwena, inoke hi lovakun ge hi nuwanuwatu hi ba, “Mani toto wala nem houwan elana hi teli pasikal wala beig gamwanaa, baena te i ahela ge ta nem e. He nuwaliya nihi pakokovela yaka nihi telela ta ola wali totuwalali loloyowanil ge wala donki nihi ahel.”
Limi ana nog elana inoke hi na hi baek Yosepa wana totuwalali elana hi ba,
“Tonowak, valila ha nem ga houwan aanan ha pwapwamola.

Yaa wama sauga sikal elana, ha vin abaveyaho elana ge abwe naha kenu, inoke wama beig ha lopwelaan, yaka maisena ge maisena wama mani ana bwata i olaolaek ha pwawaa wama beig awaliyaa. He iyahe ha pwatanim ge naha pewa pasikal.
Ge mani enuna al ha pwatanim aanan enuna al naha pwamolaya. Yaa nige ha aatena te henala wama mani toto valila i teli pasikal wama beig ona gamwaliyaa.”

Analiya totuwalali i lahe i ba, “Bahi nuku nuwanuwatu ge nuku lolovakun. Wami Yabowaine, toto tamamiu wana Yabowaine, iya te wami mani i teli wami beig gamwaliyaa. Yaa mani toto valila witi ku pwamolaya iyaka ya ahe.” Inoke i na dela Simiyon i sokal ge i pwatanik talinau elal.
Yaka totuwalali i en tukagil Yosepa wana limiya, inoke wewel i wage i pek aeliya hi ul, ge wali donki aliya i pek hi anan.
He iyaka hi hago te nasi alalati avaliya ge Yosepa nihi anan, inoke wali mulolu hi lovivina-an ge sauga Yosepa ni vin nihi pek elana.
Inoke sauga Yosepa i sikal limiya, wali mulolu bolo hi bugul tukagil limiya hi ahe ge hi pek elana. Inoke hi kululu elana maniniliya i loek bilibiliya.
Yosepa i nel elal i ba, “Tab ku molu?” Yaka abwe i nel vevehe i ba, “Valila no wasa ku pem tamamiu lilikena kaiwena. He ga i ola? Iya iyoho ya i minamina i molu?”
Anana hi lahe hi ba, “Tonowak! Ee, tamama iyoho ya i minamina ge i molu.” Yaka abwe Yosepa ana awatauwan hi ginol hi kululu elana.

Sauga Yosepa matana i lipwapwati ge Beniyamina, iya talina hot hinaliya maisena i kite, inoke i nel elal i ba, “Ami melumelu toto valila wasana ku wasaan elau heiya e?” Inoke hi talam, yaka i baek Beniyamina elana i ba, “Natu, Yabowaine ni muloluagiwa.”
Yosepa atena i lomwan nabi talina kaiwena kelaubwa ni kahin, inoke etimwawa i eguluwagil i na wana lum elana ge i kahikahin.
Sauga i pwaul yaka wewel i ahe maninina i ul, inoke atena i pagasisi al i na i tagil elal, ge i ba wana totuwalali aanan nihi habwe.

Yosepa i minaa teibol etega elana aana hi pek, talinau hi minaa teibol getoga elana aliya hi pek, ge Itipita bolo avaliyau hi anan hi minaa teibol getoga al elana aliya hi pek. Hi ginol ola o, kaiwena Itipita nige sauga etega avaliyau ge Hibilu hi aanan toyawa, amnaliya i naka hot.

He Yosepa i ba totuwalali talinau hi telel abaliyaa teibol elana. Awoliya i noek Yosepa elana ge ali vatavatal i golugoluwa wali baliman ab elana, i telipunaa ali gamaun elana i na ana siga ali melumelu. Sauga talinau ali vatavatal hi kite, inoke nuwaliya hi ahe ge hi pegagayawa-agil.

Totuwalali Yosepa talinau aliya hi habweya Yosepa wana teibol elana hi na hi pek maisena ge maisena elana. Yaa Beniyamina aana hi habwe pwabwata i ola gamagalau nimala panuna aliya ana bwata. Inoke aloliya Yosepa hi anan ge hi imwim ginebi wali yaliyaya.

footnotes.text: Ebwakil pistasiyo ge almon labi Kenani ebwakilina, enowaliya i ola kinai enowana.
Itipita Hibilu hi kite lowagil, kaiwena heliya bwasumu ali tomatahikan ge nige hi miminaa taun bwabwatal elal. Abatelipuna 46:33-34 nu kite al.
